title: US Army manuals for M880 series (military 1976-77 Dodge W-series)
summary: Maintenance manuals for the military Dodge W200/D200 pickups. US government works, public domain.
body: The M880 family were near-stock 1976-77 Dodge W200/D200 trucks with the 318 V8 and A727 automatic. Search the Internet Archive for "TM 9-2320-266" (the M880 manual series).
author: OpenBay seed (unsourced, needs citations)
